description: Institute of Environment of Professional Sri Lanka - Rules of the Institute of Environment of Professional Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Act. No. 1 of 2020 (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content contains amendments to the rules of the Institute of Environmental Professionals Sri Lanka made under Section 7 of their Incorporation Act. It deals with regulatory frameworks, legal amendments to membership criteria, financial procedures, and compliance requirements for a professional institute. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
